div.div:
NOTE1: The X-coordinate of tendon control points is defined relative to the girder and span to which the tendon is assigned, rather than using a global bridge coordinate system.
NOTE2: Tendons that are continuous over several spans should be mapped in the first span they occur (global axes)
NOTE3: Tendons that are only specific to a single span should be mapped in the span where they start.
NOTE4: Sign Convention
Vertical +ve - above Top of Girder
Vertical -ve - below Top of Girder
Transverse -ve - left side of bridge
Transverse +ve - right side of bridge
